column1: # tests/ci/shards.tsv -- the DECLARED CI shard table ([CI-SHARD], lane cishard).
# `make test-shard CISHARD=K/N` runs exactly the sections whose `shard` column is K
# (N = the highest shard number here, which .github/workflows/ci.yml's matrix
# must also list). tests/ci/check_shards.sh (make test-ci-shards, a TEST_SECTIONS
# member) holds this table to TEST_SECTIONS EXACTLY: every section in exactly one
# shard, no unknown names. Rows are kept in TEST_SECTIONS order; a section runs
# in the order it has here.
# weight_s is RUNNER seconds, re-measured from run 40465053309 (cired, 2026-10-27) over run 38354147463 (cishard2, 2026-10-13: the
# except the rows whose weight_source says ESTIMATED or LOWER BOUND (test-memfn-g2:
# its SIMD family never ran; test-startset: ran a third of its diff jobs). To
# re-measure: download a run's artifacts, then
# (it overwrites weight_s/weight_source of the measured sections and re-balances;
# re-apply the ESTIMATED labels by hand until those two are measured).
